balance-payment-link.alt: Balance payment page for one Retreat place, showing an £80 order, £30 already paid and £50 still due
balance-payment-link.caption: The page a customer opens from their payment link, naming what they booked, what they have paid and what is left.
balance-payment-link.galleryCaption: A balance page for a Retreat place with £80 ordered, £30 paid and £50 left.
balance-payment-link.socialBody: Record a deposit when an order is made, then collect and track the remaining balance later.

bundle-booking-page.alt: A booking page for a Weekend package, offering a number of packages and listing the Breakfast and Tent inside it
bundle-booking-page.caption: A package that hides nothing names each thing inside it on its own booking page.
bundle-booking-page.galleryCaption: A package booking page naming every item the buyer gets.
bundle-booking-page.socialBody: Combine listings into one bundle. Set each member's price and quantity, then let customers choose a package count.

contact-record.alt: A contact record showing 9 visits, 5 online bookings, 2 admin bookings, 4 messages sent and a private note reading VIP Sam
contact-record.caption: What the site remembers about someone, and the private note only the organiser reads.
contact-record.galleryCaption: A person's own record: how often they booked, how often they were in touch, and a private note.
contact-record.socialBody: Add walk-ins and telephone bookings alongside online bookings. Waive the price in Money when a place is complimentary.

payment-provider-choice.alt: Payment Provider settings with Stripe selected among Square, Stripe and SumUp and a configured Stripe test key
payment-provider-choice.caption: Choose one active provider and keep saved credentials available when switching.
payment-provider-choice.galleryCaption: Payment provider settings with Stripe selected and its saved test key.
payment-provider-choice.socialBody: Select Stripe, Square or SumUp. Saved credentials remain available when the organiser switches provider.

qr-code-check-in.alt: Manual check-in search on a listing's scanner page, offering Alice and her one place
qr-code-check-in.caption: Look someone up by name when their ticket cannot be scanned.
qr-code-check-in.galleryCaption: Manual check-in for someone whose ticket cannot be scanned.
qr-code-check-in.socialBody: Scan a booking QR code with a phone camera, or pick the person from the list of those still to arrive when a camera cannot be used.

servicing-studio-floor-hold.alt: Service event form holding four Ceramics Studio Session places for a two-day floor treatment
servicing-studio-floor-hold.caption: Reserve capacity for maintenance across one day or several days.
servicing-studio-floor-hold.galleryCaption: Service events hold places without adding a customer to the list.
servicing-studio-floor-hold.socialBody: Block places for maintenance, setup or staff use without adding a customer to the attendee list.
